# Understanding people through data.

I work at the intersection of statistical methods, data science, and the measurement of human outcomes.

This is a space for my work and writing on how we collect evidence, build models, and use technology to make better decisions.

## Research, methods, and applied questions
:::

My interests include statistical modeling, longitudinal data, measurement and psychometrics, AI, and applied analytics. I'm especially interested in the gap between what our data appear to say and what we can reasonably conclude from them.
